locations.note: Jack is beaten and tied up by Mr. Lee's thugs, then the Royal Secret Service sends him to ferry an agent to Tooth Island for 10,000 pounds.
Jack escapes by fetching his knife from a raven's nest at Big Ben.
In Cape Town harbour Jack gets rum for the deckhands, mails a parcel for Montgomery and sails with him on the Charming Princess.

routes.name: Jack Keane
routes.note: From the escape at Big Ben to the voyage out of Cape Town.
